skill.summary: Cloud-based easy-ai-video-editing tool that handles quickly editing raw footage into a clean shareable video. Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB),...

latestVersion.changelog:
easy-ai-video-editing 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based AI video editing for quick raw footage cleanup and export.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; delivers polished 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles authentication, session management, and error handling automatically.
- Provides plain-language editing: trim, transitions, text, audio, aspect ratio, and more via simple prompts.
- Checks credit balance, workflow state, and export status through user commands.
- Responds with easy-to-follow status updates and timeline summaries throughout the editing process.
